items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: he and I were close friends. We all saved up enough money.

ctx.x: On trombone. So we always said, we want to go to Europe. Bishop was

having trouble with his wife. She was putting him down. So we all saved up enough money and caught the Isle de France and went over there. But before we went Paradisio has been to New York, he came to New York somewhere down in that time.

items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: me and Step and Dickie Harris ..... Yes. They were all French. So now that makes us have six. Me and Bish, Step and a tenor and an alto, oh a piano.

ctx.x: Oh, I've forgotten that little boy's name, he was kind of a young kid, I've forgotten his name now. He was Eli Robinson's cousin. And Step was the second trumpet player. In other words, we had three brass and two, two, I must have had about an eight-piece band. Skinny Brown was on tenor sax. He was one of the Savoy Sultans. You remember that old Savoy Sultan, he had played with Pat Jenkins.
They had a good swinging band. But he was a tenor player and Len Davis was the alto player and me and Step and Dickie Harris .....
